title: Inspect AI: DEFER with a proven wrap pattern
summary: Do not add inspect-ai now: Agent OS's own suites run in orchestrate eval with the same results, and the capabilities Inspect would add (sandboxes, benchmark ports) are unavailable on this machine (no Docker/WSL) or need model-backed runs through a bridge. Wrapping is cheap and proven (33 lines, exact fidelity), so the trigger to revisit is concrete: the first external benchmark import from evals/external-corpora.json, or Docker/WSL becoming available, or API-key workers making benchmark-scale runs affordable. Then add it as an optional extra behind an adapter; Agent OS keeps suite definitions, scoring rules and promotion authority.
